prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1226
Claimant:
Dawn Matthews
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2024-11-15
Insured reported that the vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection, and the claimant was identified as the
driver of the other vehicle, which was stopped ahead of the insured's car.
2024-11-27
Police report on file lists the claimant as present in the vehicle at the scene, and two witnesses gave statements that
match the officer's account of the collision.
2025-02-04
Photos of the insured vehicle show front-quarter damage consistent with the described impact, and no prior damage
to that area appears in our records or the insured's account.
2025-02-06
Claimant is not represented and reported neck pain and whiplash symptoms at the scene, which is a plausible injury
for a collision of this type. Claimant was seen at urgent care the same day.
2025-02-07
Spoke with the claimant by phone. The claimant said the other car hit the insured's car from the side while the insured
was turning, with two passengers in the back seat.
2025-03-03
Follow-up call with the claimant. The claimant now describes the impact as coming from the front and says there was
only one passenger, which differs from the first account. Noted the change for the file.
2025-03-20
Reviewed the claimant's medical records. Treatment followed a typical course of physical therapy and tapered off as
the claimant improved. The records also mention a minor strian in the same area several years ago that resolved
fully.
2025-06-12
Statements suggest the lead vehicle braked sharply with no apparent cause, and the parties appear to have a prior
acquaintance. Combined with the shifting account, this pattern warrants further review before any settlement
discussion. Nothing indicates the damage predates the policy start.
2025-06-23
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and the coverage was in force at the time of loss. Referred file to the
special investigations unit for review of the account and the lead vehicle's braking.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
